Standard: The ECS meets safety-critical interface requirements (e.g., temperature, pressure, airflow, humidity) for equipment and subsystems under normal and emergency operating conditions throughout the air vehicle flight envelope. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review ICDs and subsystem specifications to establish safety-critical interface requirements for the ECS. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct system-level testing in an integration laboratory to verify that the ECS meets all safety-critical equipment and subsystem interface requirements (e.g., temperature, pressure, airflow, and humidity) in the installed environment. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight testing to verify that the ECS meets safety-critical equipment and subsystem interface requirements throughout the flight envelope.
